tips.text: Hit an enemy with Blade's Reach or Reaping Slash first; Umbral Trespass only works on a champion you have already damaged.
Use Shadow Step to cut through walls between camps and to escape. Enemies nearby see a warning on the wall you are in, so don't count on a surprise.
Don't trade blows while Shadow Step is running; damage dealt or taken cuts it short. Get into a wall before the fight starts.
Blade's Reach leaves enemies slowed. Use it to catch a runner, then close in with Reaping Slash.
Hit melee enemies to unlock Darkin Slayer and ranged ones for Shadow Assassin. Pick the form that suits the enemy team.
Transform only when you are safe at your base. You can't act for a few seconds, but you come out with full health and mana.
As Darkin Slayer, Blade's Reach knocks enemies up, so aim it to start a fight on a target you want to kill.
Use Umbral Trespass to dodge danger. You can't be targeted while inside the enemy, and you pop out with a burst of damage.

combos.name: Wall-hop Shadow Step
combos.when: When you want to cut through the jungle, escape, or flank, using any thick wall.
combos.text: Cast Shadow Step and walk into a wall to pass through the terrain. You heal on first entry, and you can come out the other side to ambush or flee.

tips.text: Dodge Infernal Chains by running toward the sides or at Aatrox. If you stay in the circle you get pulled back and hit again.
Use Blade's Reach on Aatrox first to mark him. That lets Umbral Trespass reach him from farther away.
Step out of the sweet spot at the end of The Darkin Blade. Edge hits knock you up, and the third strike is a circle.
Aatrox heals from damage he deals, so skip long fights. Trade in short bursts and leave with Shadow Step.
Aatrox's Umbral Dash can escape you. Use Reaping Slash to catch up, then Blade's Reach to slow him.
Dodge nothing for free: land Blade's Reach on Ambessa first, since it marks her and lets Umbral Trespass reach her from far away.
Use Umbral Trespass when Ambessa commits to Public Execution on a teammate; Kayn is untargetable while attached, so you can wait out the danger.
Slow Ambessa with Blade's Reach when she dashes in, then step away from her short-range spins.
Do not fight her right after she braces with Repudiation; the shield and slam make a short trade bad for you.
Use Shadow Step to escape through walls before a fight turns, but she can still see the warning on the terrain edge.
Dodge Bandage Toss; being stunned by it leaves you stuck for the follow-up.
Don't stand near Amumu's allies when Curse of the Sad Mummy is ready, and don't dive in with Umbral Trespass at him.
Use Blade's Reach to slow Amumu when he rushes in; it also marks him for Umbral Trespass.
Avoid long fights beside Amumu; Despair hurts high-health targets, so poke him from range instead.
Hit Bel'Veth with Blade's Reach first so Umbral Trespass can reach her from far away, then use it to jump on her.
Use Blade's Reach to keep Bel'Veth slowed when she tries to chase or fight you; her attack speed is hard to trade with.
Use Shadow Step to cut through walls and escape or reposition. Fighting her while it is active shortens it, so use it before the fight starts.
Do not trap yourself in a long fight with her Royal Maelstrom; she takes less damage and heals while it runs. Burst her before it, or wait until it ends.
Dodge Sear. Brand needs to land a spell first, so a missed Sear means no stun.
Sidestep Pillar of Flame; it has a short delay before it erupts, so move as soon as you see it.
Use Blade's Reach to slow Brand, then close in with Reaping Slash. Brand is fragile once you reach him.
Stay away from your allies when Brand casts Pyroclasm. The first missile is slow, so you can react.
Hit Briar with Blade's Reach before you try Umbral Trespass; it only works on enemies you have already damaged.
Use Shadow Step to slip through walls and escape when Briar closes in, but know it ends fast once you take or deal damage.
Briar is stunned by nothing of yours, so keep your distance after Blade's Reach slows her, and fight on your terms.
Hold Umbral Trespass for when Briar is locked onto you in her frenzy; you become untargetable and can dodge her burst.

comboRefs.note: Walking through walls lets Kayn escape or flank around Briar's leaps and stun, and heals him.

tips.text: Dodge Apprehend by moving out of its cone. Getting pulled in leaves you knocked up next to Darius.
Poke Darius with Blade's Reach from long range, and do it while his Apprehend is on cooldown.
Don't stay in melee with Darius. His Hemorrhage stacks build quickly and make his damage much higher.
Use Umbral Trespass to dodge Darius's burst. Kayn can't be targeted while inside the enemy, so Noxian Guillotine can't hit him.
Use Reaping Slash to dash away from Darius and keep your distance. It also hurts him when you pass through him.
Dodge Crescent Strike. If Moonlight is on you, back away, because Diana can dash to you with Lunar Rush and use it again.
Use Blade's Reach on Diana when she dashes in; it slows her, and it is also what lets you reach her with Umbral Trespass.
Wait for the Pale Cascade shield and orbs to run out before you fight Diana.
Stay away from teammates stacked near Diana at level 6; Moonfall pulls everyone in and hits harder for each champion.
Don't rely on Blade's Reach to hold Dr. Mundo; his passive can resist the first stun or root, so the knock up may be wasted.
Step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops to destroy it, so he can't heal from it.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw by sidestepping; it travels in a straight line and hits the first enemy, so keep a minion between you.
Burst Dr. Mundo down quickly after he uses Maximum Dosage, or he heals through your damage; otherwise walk away.
Use Shadow Step to slip away when Dr. Mundo is chasing, and keep clear of him while his Heart Zapper is charging.
Land Blade's Reach on Ekko before you use Umbral Trespass. It marks him, and Ekko cannot easily slip out once you are attached.
Wait for Ekko to use Chronobreak before you commit to a long fight. He is much weaker with it down.
Use Shadow Step to cross walls and reach Ekko from an angle he does not expect. Avoid casting it while Ekko is near, since he can see the warning on the wall.
Stay out of Parallel Convergence once it appears. Being stunned there will end Shadow Step and get you killed.
Step sideways out of Timewinder's line, and move away from the field it leaves behind. Staying inside leaves you slowed and hit a second time.
Dodge Evelynn's Allure by staying near allies; once the mark has matured, the charm leaves you open to a full combo.
Use Shadow Step through walls to escape when Evelynn marks you; but damage will cut it short, so leave before she hits you.
Hit Evelynn with Blade's Reach when she shows herself; it slows her so you can fight or walk away.
Stay healthy and ward your jungle; Evelynn's Last Caress finishes low-health targets, so back off when you are low.
Dodge Blade's Reach, so Kayn does not mark Fiddlesticks for a long-range Umbral Trespass. Without damage, he is not marked.
Check brush and standing scarecrows before fighting. If Fiddlesticks is unseen, Reap or Crowstorm will fear you.
Do not run straight into Fiddlesticks. Keep your Reaping Slash or Shadow Step for after Reap, so his silence cannot trap you.
Leave Fiddlesticks' Crowstorm area at once; it does heavy damage over time. Umbral Trespass makes you untargetable, so it can dodge the damage.
Dodge Graves' Smoke Screen or walk out of it quickly; it slows you only briefly, but inside you can't see far.
Dive Graves with Umbral Trespass once he has used Quickdraw; he is easier to burst when his escape is on cooldown.
Hit Graves with Blade's Reach to slow him; it also lets you mark him for Umbral Trespass.
Don't stand in a straight line from Graves; End of the Line hits twice along its path.
Hit Gwen with Blade's Reach first so she is marked, then dive with Umbral Trespass. Wait until she has used Hallowed Mist.
Do not start a fight while Gwen is standing in Hallowed Mist; she is untargetable to anyone outside it. Wait for the Mist to end or for her to leave it.
Use Shadow Step to escape Gwen's Needlework slows through walls. Damage or hitting a champion cuts it short, so leave before you trade.
Gwen needs a few attacks to build up her damage, so jump her before she has hit anything. Open with Reaping Slash to catch her early.
Dodge Hecarim's Devastating Charge by moving sideways; he must reach you with his next attack for it to work.
Hit Hecarim with Blade's Reach to slow him, then fight or walk away on your terms.
Spread from your team near Hecarim, since Onslaught of Shadows fears everyone it lands near.
Burst Hecarim fast with Umbral Trespass; he heals with Spirit of Dread in long fights.
Gank when Ivern is planting a grove on a camp; he can't act while channeling, so he's easy to catch.
Hit Ivern with Blade's Reach first so he is slowed, then follow with Umbral Trespass to finish him.
Use Shadow Step to walk through walls and flank Ivern's brush ambush spots, but watch for his Rootcaller as you come out.
Dodge Rootcaller; if you are rooted, Ivern's team can dash in on you.
Fight Ivern away from Daisy; her third hit on you knocks you up.
Dodge the line of Dragon Strike and the path to the Demacian Standard. Getting knocked up there leaves you open to his full combo.
Hit Jarvan with Blade's Reach to slow him when he commits. Then back off or finish the fight.
Use Shadow Step to slip through walls out of his Cataclysm ring. Terrain does not block it.
Damage Jarvan first, then use Umbral Trespass to reach him. It needs a marked target.
Wait until Counter Strike ends before you attack Jax; your basic attacks get dodged while it is up.
Hit Jax with Blade's Reach first so you can use Umbral Trespass on him from a long way off.
Trade in short bursts and back off; Jax gets dangerous when he can attack many times in a row.
Use Shadow Step to escape through walls when Jax is on you, but expect a stun from Counter Strike if you stay close.
Kayn, dodge nothing less than Shock Blast: it's a fast bolt that stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and Jayce.
Hit Jayce with Blade's Reach first, so you can mark him and then use Umbral Trespass from range.
Thundering Blow can knock you back. Fight beside walls and use Reaping Slash to close the gap again.
Avoid long fights with Jayce early. Play safe until you reach your transformation.
Blade's Reach slows Jayce, so use it to stop him leaping away with To the Skies!.

comboRefs.note: Wall-hop Shadow Step lets Kayn escape or flank around Jayce's To the Skies! leap and Slow.

tips.text: Dodge Wall of Pain or wait it out; crossing it slows you and lowers your Magic Resist.
Karthus is weak up close. Dash in with Reaping Slash and fight him before he can place Lay Waste.
Use Shadow Step through walls to flank Karthus, but remember that taking or dealing damage cuts it short.
Move away from Karthus's corpse after you kill him. Death Defied lets him keep casting for a few seconds.
Stay out of Requiem's beam of light when you can, and keep your health high. Kayn can hide inside terrain when the channel starts.
Stay near minions, allies or turrets. Kha'Zix does far less with Taste Their Fear when you are not isolated.
Use Blade's Reach when Kha'Zix jumps in. It slows him heavily, so you can fight back or get away.
Fight Kha'Zix when Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown. He is weak and cannot escape or reach you easily.
Do not count on Shadow Step to flee a fight. Damage from Kha'Zix cuts it short.
Dodge nothing, aim everything: land Blade's Reach on Kindred first so she is marked and you can jump in with Umbral Trespass from far away.
Kindred is fragile, so go for her with Umbral Trespass when she has no teammates near. It makes you untargetable for a short time.
Blade's Reach slows Kindred, so she can't easily kite away. Follow with Reaping Slash to close in and hit her twice.
Don't use Umbral Trespass when Lamb's Respite is up. Nobody inside can die, so wait for it to end first.
Use Shadow Step through walls to flank Kindred or escape her slow. Taking damage shortens it, so start it before the fight.
Dodge Lee Sin's Sonic Wave; if it misses, he cannot dash to you with Resonating Strike.
Stay spread out from your team so Dragon's Rage cannot knock Lee Sin's target into your allies.
Use Blade's Reach on Lee Sin to slow him when he engages, then fight him while his abilities are down.
Hit Lee Sin with magic damage when you can; his Safeguard and Iron Will are strongest against physical damage.
Dodge Lillia's Swirlseed or hit her first with Blade's Reach; you need to damage her before Umbral Trespass can target her.
Use Umbral Trespass to become untargetable while Lillia's Lilting Lullaby is coming. It also stops her from easily finishing you off.
Use Blade's Reach to keep Lillia slowed when she tries to kite you with her speed. Then close in with Reaping Slash.
Take Shadow Step through walls to dodge her Swirlseed and escape. Avoid hitting or being hit by her, since that cuts it short.
Slow Master Yi with Blade's Reach early, before he starts Highlander. Once it is active he ignores slows.
Master Yi can't be slowed during Highlander, so use other crowd control to stop him. Darkin Blade's Reach knocks him up.
Wait until Master Yi uses Alpha Strike before using Umbral Trespass. He is untargetable while it lasts.
Hit Master Yi a few times so he has to spend mana on Meditate. Don't waste your damage while he is channeling it.
Use Shadow Step to get away through walls when Master Yi starts chasing.

comboRefs.note: Shadow Step lets Kayn pass through walls to flee or flank Master Yi, who must chase through terrain.

tips.text: Dodge Wukong's Nimbus Strike by keeping minions or camps between you; he needs a target to dash to.
Wait a moment before using abilities after Wukong dashes in, since Warrior Trickster may have left a clone in his place.
Do not stand in melee with Wukong when he has Cyclone ready; it knocks you up and hurts more against high max Health.
Use Shadow Step to slip away through walls when Wukong has used his dash, but he can chase if you take damage.
Keep fights short; Stone Skin makes Wukong tougher the longer he keeps hitting you.
Dodge nothing for her: instead aim Blade's Reach at Naafiri first so she is slowed, then chase with Umbral Trespass while she cannot get away.
Use Shadow Step to slip through walls and reach her from an angle, but expect her to see the warning on the wall edge.
Fight her away from her Packmates; they add damage to every fight, so clear them or pick fights when they are few.
Do not waste Umbral Trespass while she is untargetable; wait until her Call of the Pack ends, then mark and dive her.
Dodge Nidalee's Javelin Toss, especially from far away. A hit marks you as Hunted and sets up her cougar burst.
Use Blade's Reach on Nidalee when she jumps in; it slows her, and as Rhaast it also knocks her up.
Walk around brush where Bushwhack traps may be hidden, or fight outside the brush. Hitting a trap sets up a Hunt for her.
Damage on Nidalee marks her, so you can leap onto her with Umbral Trespass and avoid her burst while you are untargetable.

comboRefs.note: Shadow Step through walls lets Kayn escape Nidalee's Pounce chase and Javelin Toss lines.

tips.text: Dodge Nocturne's Duskbringer; it is a thin line, and a hit leaves a trail that speeds him up and shows where you are.
Break away from Nocturne when he starts Unspeakable Horror. Getting out of range cancels the fear.
Bait out Shroud of Darkness before you use Umbral Trespass, because a shield makes it fail.
Stay near your team when Nocturne casts Paranoia. His dash then has a hard time catching you alone.
Use Blade's Reach to slow Nocturne when he dashes in. A slowed Nocturne is easier to kite.
Walk around the line of Biggest Snowball Ever! with sharp turns, not a straight run; it turns slowly.
Dodge Snowball Barrage, or move away before it ends, so you aren't rooted next to Nunu.
Use Shadow Step to slip through walls and escape or reposition when Nunu rolls at you. Damage ends it early, so use it before a fight.
Get out of Absolute Zero early, or interrupt it, because it hurts more the longer it channels. Umbral Trespass can't be used to escape it.
Land Blade's Reach on Nunu first, since Umbral Trespass needs a damaged target to jump to.
Dodge Pantheon's hurled Comet Spear when you are low on health; it deals big damage to weakened targets.
Walk around to Pantheon's back or wait out Aegis Assault; he is immune to damage from the front while it channels.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, you get a warning; move away from the landing area or set up your fight.
Hit Pantheon with Blade's Reach to slow him before he gets in, and keep your distance so Shield Vault has less to stun.
Dodge Blade's Reach? No: land it on Qiyana first, since Umbral Trespass only works on an enemy you have already damaged.
Hit Qiyana with Blade's Reach to leave her slowed, then follow with Reaping Slash while she struggles to get away.
Use Umbral Trespass to dodge Qiyana's Supreme Display of Talent; Kayn can't be targeted while inside an enemy.
Do not fight Qiyana inside the river or brush where she can use Terrashape freely; the walls and water power her up. Fight her on open ground.

comboRefs.note: Walking through walls with Shadow Step lets Kayn avoid Qiyana's terrain-detonating ultimate.

tips.text: Don't spend your damage into Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up. Your physical damage does little and he reflects damage back at you.
Stay out of Frenzying Taunt range when you are about to fight. Being taunted leaves you unable to cast anything.
Hit Rammus right after his Defensive Ball Curl ends. His defenses are much lower then.
Use Shadow Step to get away through walls when Powerball is coming for you.
Hit Rek'Sai with Reaping Slash or Blade's Reach first, so Umbral Trespass has a marked target and you can jump on her.
Use Blade's Reach to get her slowed when she tries to burrow away or tunnel out of a fight.
Slip into a wall with Shadow Step to escape her when she has dived on you, but stay out of fights since damage cuts it short.
Don't clump near the Rek'Sai tunnels you can see; stand on a tunnel entrance briefly to destroy it.
Fight Rengar when his Ferocity is low. An empowered ability, especially Bola Strike's root, is what makes him deadly.
Stay away from brush. Unseen Predator lets Rengar leap onto you from far away.
Hit Rengar with Blade's Reach when he leaps in. The slow cuts his chase, and the hit also marks him for Umbral Trespass.
Watch for the indicator over your head. It means Rengar is camouflaged with Thrill of the Hunt and is coming for you.
Dodge Arctic Assault. Stay out of its line when Sejuani is close, because a hit knocks you up and sets up her team.
Do not fight Sejuani with your Shadow Step on cooldown. Damage or a stun ends it early, and she has plenty of both.
Slow Sejuani with Blade's Reach to start a fight. Her passive makes her immune to slows while Frost Armor is up, so wait until she has taken damage.
Move away from Sejuani's melee allies when you are fighting. Their attacks stack Frost on you for her Permafrost stun.
Dodge Blade's Reach slashes only when needed; Shaco is fragile, so hit him with it when he steps in to attack.
Be careful walking through bushes and wall paths without vision; Shaco's hidden Jack In The Box can fear and root you.
After Shaco uses Deceive to jump on you, fight back at once; he can't easily use it again to flee.
Hit Shaco first with Reaping Slash so Umbral Trespass can mark him, then jump on him when he is exposed.
Keep your distance from Shyvana and hit her with Blade's Reach when she walks up; she gets strong only when she can attack you.
Avoid fighting Shyvana while she has Dragon's Descent ready or is already in dragon form; poke her while she is low on fury.
Use Reaping Slash to dash out of her range after trading, since Molten Burst slows you if it lands.
Use Shadow Step to escape through walls when Shyvana has the upper hand; she cannot follow you into terrain.
Avoid Blade's Reach on Skarner only when it's safe. Skarner's Ixtal's Impact can pull you into a wall and stun you, so stay away from walls when he charges.
Save Umbral Trespass for after Skarner uses Impale, or use it to escape a gank, since you can't be targeted while inside your target.
Hit Skarner with Blade's Reach to slow him, then trade. Skarner has to close the gap to land his damage.
Don't let a long fight run on. Skarner's Quaking builds up over several hits, so trade in short bursts and step away.
Dodge Sylas's Abduct when you can; he stuns and pulls himself onto you, and that is the opening he wants.
Hit Sylas with Blade's Reach first so Umbral Trespass has a marked target, then jump on him when his dashes are on cooldown.
Finish Sylas fast when he is low; Kingslayer heals him most at low health, so burst him instead of chipping.
Don't use Umbral Trespass when Sylas can steal it with Hijack; he gets a copy to use on you.
Use Shadow Step to slip through walls away from Sylas's Chain Lash, but remember that getting hit shortens it.
Dodge Talon's Rake if you can; the blades hit again on the way back and slow you. Step out of the cone.
Hit Talon with Blade's Reach when he jumps in; it slows him hard and lets you trade back.
Talon relies on Shadow Assault to get away. When it is down, chase him with Umbral Trespass.
Talon vaults walls with Assassin's Path, so don't count on terrain to lose him. Shadow Step can cross walls too, but damage shortens it.
Do not fight Trundle on his Frozen Domain. Pull the fight off the ice or wait for it to run out.
Step out of Pillar of Ice quickly, because it slows you. Do not chase Trundle through it.
Keep your distance from Trundle when Subjugate is ready. It shrinks your resistances and heals him, so do not duel him after it lands.
Use Blade's Reach to slow Trundle when he runs in, then leave rather than trading into his Chomp.
Dodge Blade's Reach when you see it coming. If it hits, you are slowed and Udyr can stick to you.
Do not stand and fight when Udyr's Blazing Stampede is active. His attack dashes onto you and stuns you.
Hit Udyr first, then use Umbral Trespass to finish him. His shield can absorb some of the damage, so wait until it is gone.
Use Reaping Slash to get away when Udyr's Wingborne Storm slows you. Stay out of its range.

comboRefs.note: Shadow Step through walls lets Kayn escape Udyr's Stampede stun-dash and Storm slow.

tips.text: Dodge Vault Breaker's punch by stepping sideways, or use Shadow Step to walk away. A fully charged punch hits hard and sends you flying back.
Don't trade blows for long. Her Denting Blows strips your Armor on the third hit and speeds up her attacks.
Slow her with Blade's Reach when she charges Vault Breaker, then back away so she can't line up the punch.
Don't hold Shadow Step for a Vi fight. Once either of you deals damage, it ends fast.
Use Umbral Trespass on Vi after she has been hit, and you can't be targeted while it plays out. It is a good way to dodge her Cease and Desist.
Dodge Spectral Maw's charged blast if you can; getting stunned by it in a fight is the biggest threat to your Umbral Trespass plans.
Hit Viego with Blade's Reach first, then use Umbral Trespass on him; it needs a marked target, and the mark comes from damage.
Use Blade's Reach to slow Viego when he dashes in with Spectral Maw, then back away from his follow-up.
Do not rely on Shadow Step to flee a fight; being stunned or hurt shortens it, and Viego has a stun.
Take Viego's kills seriously: if he kills someone, he can possess them and heal. Fight away from fresh corpses, and kill him before he gets the wraith.
Dodge Volibear's Sky Splitter; it slows you and hits hard on max Health. Step out of the circle after the first moment.
Hit Volibear with Blade's Reach as he runs in. If he is immobilized during Thundering Smash, it ends early.
Use Shadow Step to escape when Volibear stuns you or leaps in. Stay out of fights where his Health is high.
Fight Volibear before Frenzied Maul can bite twice. Break off after the first hit so he cannot heal.
Dodge Warwick's Jaws of the Beast; if you get hit, he heals and can stay on you.
Stay above half health around Warwick. Below that, Eternal Hunger heals him and Blood Hunt tracks you.
Slow Warwick with Blade's Reach when he runs at you, since you can't outrun him once he is chasing.
Don't commit while Primal Howl is up; he takes less damage and the howl makes you flee.
Use Shadow Step to escape through walls before Warwick reaches you, since his leap needs a clear path to hit.
Dodge Wind Becomes Lightning; if it hits, you are slowed and Challenged, so Xin Zhao can charge you from farther away.
Stay out of Xin Zhao's reach while his Three Talon Strike is ready; the third hit knocks you up.
Use Blade's Reach to slow Xin Zhao when he charges at you, then back away.
Don't use Umbral Trespass on Xin Zhao just before he casts Crescent Guard; it makes him immune to enemies outside its range.
Step on Zac's goo chunks to destroy them; it denies his healing, so fight near them.
Hit Zac with Blade's Reach so he is slowed, then use Umbral Trespass on him once he is marked.
Use Shadow Step to slip through walls when Zac charges Elastic Slingshot. Stay out of his landing area, since it knocks you up.
When Zac splits into bloblets, kill them all and he dies for good. Do not chase him alone while they are alive.
Do not fight Zac close to his Unstable Matter without a plan, because it hurts more against high-health targets and he gets his chunks back quickly.
Land Blade's Reach on Zed before you try Umbral Trespass; you need to have damaged him first, and the swipe also slows him.
Zed is untargetable while he dashes with Death Mark, but you can still go after him once it ends. Use Umbral Trespass to stay on him when he swaps away.
Keep Shadow Step ready in fights with Zed. Zed's shadows slow you, and Shadow Step gives you speed to chase or run.
Hit Zed with Reaping Slash and walk away if he has used Living Shadow. His damage and mobility are lower until it returns.
Dodge nothing for free: Zyra's Grasping Roots ends Shadow Step at once if it roots you, so don't rely on walls when she has it ready.
Hit Zyra with Blade's Reach first, then use Umbral Trespass to jump on her; she has little way to get away from you once you land.
Step on her seeds as you walk by; they are destroyed and cannot grow into plants against you.
Fight Zyra away from her seeds and plants. Without them she is much weaker, so pull the fight to a new spot.
Use Reaping Slash to close in on Zyra, since her Deadly Spines is slow to land and easy to sidestep with a dash.
